summary: Enhance your skills with our Policy Analysis and Development Training Course. Learn to create effective policies and drive impactful change in your organization
lede: Policy development training helps policy analysts, programme managers and regulatory specialists turn evidence into defensible, implementable recommendations. You’ll practise defining problems, appraising evidence and comparing options using tools such as problem trees, cost-benefit analysis and logic models, then map stakeholders, test delivery assumptions and select indicators for monitoring.
audienceIntro: Policy analysis is relevant to professionals who must define public or organizational problems, assess intervention choices, coordinate evidence, and communicate recommendations to decision-makers. The course suits foundation to intermediate learners who contribute to policy design, review, implementation, regulation, research, or programme evaluation.
prerequisites: No formal policy qualification is required. You should have basic familiarity with organizational decision-making, research, programme delivery, or regulatory work. A working ability to read tables, interpret simple evidence, and use spreadsheet software is helpful. No coding or programming is required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted evidence synthesis and dashboard design are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application levels, not technical engineering level.
